content_text: Latest podcast features Alec Litowitz, the Founder of Magnetar Capital and now the Founder and CIO of QStar Capital. Alec is a tremendous investor and thinker on markets and the author of "The Adaptability Quotient", a book that details his framework for decision-making under uncertainty. Our conversation covers a lot of ground! Apple Podcast: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/alec-litowitz-founder-of-magnetar-capital-and/id1442284870?i=1000778667077 Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/episode/37w2GmZoodKI6EtcEWygRO YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zU7cQl4Sqt8
